payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline models used in the context of speech translation, including pre-training and multi-task settings.

claims.text: The pre-training baselines include encoder pre-training, decoder pre-training, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
The vanilla ST baseline consists of only a speech encoder and a decoder.
Multi-task baselines include one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
The Triangle model is fine-tuned under a multi-task manner.
